text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This race is... ugh, I can't afford to 
give up this race...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because this is... the race that 
Maruzen-san won, after aaalllll!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...What strong, resolute eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I could defeat her, possessor of those 
eyes... If I could master a martial might 
surpassing that spirit of hers...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the goosebumps rising on my 
skin... My pounding pulse is driving my 
legs forward...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa. I swear I will surpass that girl 
and become a stronger version of myself—!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Chiyono O has returned!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So, Trainer-san, regarding our next 
target race—"
choice_data_list: Of course, on to the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the first leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown—a challenge you can only take 
on once in a lifetime, just like the 
Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Truly, "the gates open, and time waits for 
no one"! Kuuu~~, I'm all fired up and 
ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And starting from a few days later, I 
immediately began training with an eager 
Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... whew~... That finishes 
today's training menu...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...? The one running over there is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. You're still training, 
aren't you? Surely preparing for the 
Classic races—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Trainer-san! Can I do just one more 
lap, please?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to do my best and not lose either!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Sakura Chiyono O started running once 
again. Full of energy, cheerfully kicking 
up the turf—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Do your best, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hold tight to so very many things in both 
your hands, okay? Even the things I was 
never able to reach.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Maruzen. If you want to run, you can 
just run."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...CB-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to hold back and watch it 
pass you by. You don't have to force 
yourself to act like an adult."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't it a bit too early to hand over 
the dreams carried by the "Supercar" to 
someone else?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...It can't just be anyone. It has to be 
her."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've already decided to dedicate 
everything to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
News of the two of them has not yet 
reached Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Sakura Chiyono O's first goal is 
the Satsuki Sho.
